FAQ

Have questions? We have answers

What is the difference between AEO, GEO and AI SEO?
Mostly the label. Answer engine optimization (AEO) is about earning the direct answer in Google's answer boxes, AI Overviews and voice results. Generative engine optimization (GEO) is the same discipline aimed at ChatGPT, Perplexity and other generative engines that write their own answers and cite sources. AI SEO is the umbrella term people use for both. Our program covers all three because the inputs overlap almost entirely: structured data, entity clarity, answer-first content and authority signals.
What is Answer Engine Optimization?
AEO is the process of structuring and optimizing content to directly address user queries in a way AI assistants and search engines can easily understand, extract, and display across answer boxes, featured snippets, AI Overviews, and voice results. It goes beyond traditional SEO by addressing how AI engines process and select content.
How does AEO differ from traditional SEO?
AEO focuses on how content is structured and interpreted by AI tools and large language models, not just search engines. It emphasizes direct answers, schema markup, and conversational clarity, while SEO focuses on ranking pages for keywords.
Why is AI SEO important for my brand?
As search shifts toward AI-driven results, AI SEO maximizes your visibility, builds authority, and positions your brand as the trusted source across evolving touchpoints, from Google's AI Overviews to tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
What is Google AI Mode?
Google's AI Mode (AI Overviews) displays generative summaries above traditional results. AEO strategies help your content get cited within these overviews, earning front-row visibility in a zero-click environment.
How long does it take to see results?
Most brands begin to see early wins (increased snippet presence and AI mentions) within 30 to 90 days. Long-term results compound as we refine your AEO strategy and content ecosystem.
How much does AEO cost?
Professional SEO services generally start at $3,500/month and scale with business requirements. AEO cost varies with your goals, competition, current authority, backlink portfolio, and volume of content production.
